questions.question: What is my total unrealized P&L?
questions.answer: Your calculable unrealized P&L across active accounts is **-$211,833.44**. The calculation covers 106 position–instrument pairs using each account’s latest available position snapshot; none of those pairs had incomplete market value or open-lot cost-basis data.
evidence: Position history was limited to each scoped account’s latest available snapshot; scoped accounts were active accounts under advisor_id 1.
For all 106 position–instrument pairs, unrealized P&L was calculated as market value minus total cost basis from OPEN tax lots; incomplete pairs: 0.
Sum of the calculable pair-level unrealized P&L: -211833.44.
assumptions: Position/instrument pairs without complete OPEN tax-lot cost basis or market value are excluded from the calculable subtotal and counted as incomplete.
